name: 20_recipe
task: Dictating a recipe: spoken heading command, ingredient quantities to figures, 'make that a list' restructure, numbered-ish steps.

turns.say: You'll need two pounds of tomatoes, one large onion, four cloves of garlic, and two cups of vegetable stock.
First, roast the tomatoes at four hundred degrees for twenty five minutes.
Then sauté the onion until golden, about eight minutes.
Finally, blend everything together and simmer for ten more minutes.

judge.criteria: A usable recipe: title heading, ingredients as a list with figures (2 lbs, 4 cloves, 2 cups), steps in order with temperatures/times as figures.
